name: Honey
description: The blessed sweetener of every tradition's medicine chest.

ayurveda.note: Ushna — and never to be cooked, per classical rule.

histamine.note: Generally well tolerated in modest amounts.

guna.note: Sattvic raw. The texts are unusually specific that heating honey spoils it.

effects.note: A Cochrane review of six trials in nearly 900 children found honey eases cough better than placebo, diphenhydramine, and no treatment, and holds its own against dextromethorphan — a genuinely well-studied piece of kitchen-cabinet folk medicine. The trials used anywhere from half a teaspoon to two teaspoons depending on the child's age — a teaspoonful before bed sits inside that range, though a heaping tablespoon runs past what most of them tested. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
